analyzed_vuln.description: In the DIGIT_BIT==64 path, sp_384_from_mp copies `a->used` limbs with `XMEMCPY(r, a->dp, sizeof(sp_digit) * a->used)` without bounding `a->used` by the destination `size`. In this PoV, caller `sp_ecc_mulmod_384` allocates `k` for exactly 6 limbs (48 bytes) and calls `sp_384_from_mp(k, 6, km)`, but `km->used` is larger (7), causing a 56-byte memcpy into a 48-byte heap buffer (heap-buffer-overflow).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via ECC point multiplication on a 384-bit modulus path (`wc_ecc_mulmod_ex` -> `sp_ecc_mulmod_384`) when scalar/input mp_int (`km`) has more than 6 64-bit limbs (`used > 6`). The code routes to P-384 based on modulus bit length, but does not enforce/trim scalar limb count before conversion; `sp_384_from_mp` then over-copies into fixed-size SP buffers.
